verdict.rationale: Datadog's Bits AI (datadog-docs-4) is documented as an AI assistant feature integrated with Incident Management (datadog-docs-14), aligning with AI-generated incident summaries/alert context, but the evidence pack only lists a doc title without detailed feature description or independent/hands-on validation of summary quality. Missing for 10: detailed first-party documentation of Bits AI's incident-summary capability, and independent/community corroboration of its effectiveness.
